statement: 病毒感染草鱼后，其抗病毒相关基因甲基化水平改变，进而影响对病毒的抗性。
text_zh: 病毒感染草鱼后，其抗病毒相关基因甲基化水平改变，进而影响对病毒的抗性。
text_en: After grass carp are infected with a virus, the methylation levels of their antiviral-related genes change, thereby affecting resistance to the virus.

quote: 在草鱼的甲基化研究中指出，使用一定浓度的嗜水气单胞菌处理，经过不同时间点的取样后，进行甲基化检测发现，经过三天的处理组草鱼甲基化水平显著升高（李立森 2017）。
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌处理草鱼三天后，甲基化水平显著升高。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌处理草鱼三天后，甲基化水平显著升高。
text_en: Three days after Aeromonas hydrophila treatment, the methylation level in grass carp increased significantly.

quote: 虽然通常情况下鳜鱼拒食非活饵食物，但是经过人工驯化后，鳜鱼会开始摄食死饵甚至是人工配合饲料 (Liang et al 1998, Liang et al 2001)。
statement: 鳜鱼经人工驯化后可摄食死饵及人工配合饲料。
text_zh: 鳜鱼经人工驯化后可摄食死饵及人工配合饲料。
text_en: After artificial acclimation, mandarin fish can consume dead bait and formulated feed.

quote: 早期经过不断地探索，发现鳜鱼可以经过专门的驯食程序以成功摄食人工颗粒饲料，而且存活率较高（梁旭方 1994，梁旭方 1995a，梁旭方 1995b）。
statement: 鳜鱼通过专门驯食程序可成功摄食人工颗粒饲料且存活率较高。
text_zh: 鳜鱼通过专门驯食程序可成功摄食人工颗粒饲料且存活率较高。
text_en: Mandarin fish can successfully consume artificial pellet feed through a specialized feeding training program and have a high survival rate.

quote: D1 组FC 显著高于其他组 (P < 0.05)，且在D3 组达到最低。
statement: D1组的饲料系数(FC)显著高于其他组，而D3组的饲料系数最低。
text_zh: D1组的饲料系数(FC)显著高于其他组，而D3组的饲料系数最低。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio (FCR) of group D1 was significantly higher than that of the other groups, while group D3 had the lowest FCR.

quote: 随着LNA/LA 比例的增高，鳜鱼肠道绒毛长度呈现先升高后降低的趋势
statement: 随着饲料中亚麻酸与亚油酸比例的增加，鳜鱼的肠道绒毛长度呈现先升高后降低的变化趋势。
text_zh: 随着饲料中亚麻酸与亚油酸比例的增加，鳜鱼的肠道绒毛长度呈现先升高后降低的变化趋势。
text_en: As the ratio of linolenic acid to linoleic acid in the feed increased, the intestinal villus length of mandarin fish showed a trend of first increasing and then decreasing.

quote: D1 组肠道绒毛长度显著低于其余四组 (P < 0.05)
statement: D1组的肠道绒毛长度显著低于其他四个实验组。
text_zh: D1组的肠道绒毛长度显著低于其他四个实验组。
text_en: The intestinal villus length of group D1 was significantly lower than that of the other four experimental groups.

quote: D3 组肠道绒毛长度最长，且显著高于其余四组 (P < 0.05)
statement: D3组的肠道绒毛长度最长，且显著高于其他四个实验组。
text_zh: D3组的肠道绒毛长度最长，且显著高于其他四个实验组。
text_en: The intestinal villus length in the D3 group was the longest and significantly higher than that of the other four experimental groups.

quote: 各处理组肠道绒毛杯状细胞的数目无差异；同时未发现肠道炎症因子。
statement: 各处理组之间肠道绒毛杯状细胞的数量没有显著差异，且未观察到肠道炎症因子。
text_zh: 各处理组之间肠道绒毛杯状细胞的数量没有显著差异，且未观察到肠道炎症因子。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the number of intestinal villus goblet cells among treatment groups, and no intestinal inflammatory factors were observed.

quote: 肝脏细胞形态结构正常，并且排列规则，未发现肝脏损坏相关的炎症细胞浸润现象。
statement: 肝脏细胞形态结构正常且排列规则，未发现与肝脏损伤相关的炎症细胞浸润。
text_zh: 肝脏细胞形态结构正常且排列规则，未发现与肝脏损伤相关的炎症细胞浸润。
text_en: The morphological structure of liver cells was normal and regularly arranged, with no inflammatory cell infiltration associated with liver damage observed.

quote: D3 组HDL 的含量显著高于其余组（除D5 组）(P < 0.05)，呈先升高后降低的趋势（除D5 组）
statement: D3组的高密度脂蛋白含量显著高于除D5组以外的其他各组，整体呈现先升高后降低的趋势。
text_zh: D3组的高密度脂蛋白含量显著高于除D5组以外的其他各组，整体呈现先升高后降低的趋势。
text_en: The HDL content in the D3 group was significantly higher than that in all other groups except the D5 group, showing an overall trend of first increasing and then decreasing.

quote: 同时已有结果表明，在狼鲈 (Dicentrarchus labrax)中，不同水平的PUFA 添加会影响肝脏转氨酶活性，从而影响鱼体肝脏健康(Lemaire et al 1991)。
statement: 在狼鲈中，不同水平PUFA添加影响肝脏转氨酶活性及肝脏健康。
text_zh: 在狼鲈中，不同水平PUFA添加影响肝脏转氨酶活性及肝脏健康。
text_en: In wolf perch, different levels of PUFA supplementation affect liver transaminase activity and liver health.

quote:
（6）基于生长指标进行折线回归分析发现，鳜鱼饲料中LNA/LA 的最适添加比值
为0.81。
statement: 基于生长指标的折线回归分析显示，鳜鱼饲料中LNA/LA最适添加比值为0.81。
text_zh: 基于生长指标的折线回归分析显示，鳜鱼饲料中LNA/LA最适添加比值为0.81。
text_en: Broken-line regression analysis based on growth indicators showed that the optimal LNA/LA addition ratio in mandarin fish feed was 0.81.

quote: 益生菌PSB 和硝化细菌的添加可以改善翘嘴鳜池塘养殖水质，也有利于沉积营养和保持良好水质环境。
statement: 添加光合细菌（PSB）和硝化细菌能够改善翘嘴鳜池塘的水质，并有助于沉积营养及维持良好的水环境。
text_zh: 添加光合细菌（PSB）和硝化细菌能够改善翘嘴鳜池塘的水质，并有助于沉积营养及维持良好的水环境。
text_en: Adding photosynthetic bacteria (PSB) and nitrifying bacteria can improve the water quality of Chinese perch ponds, and help deposit nutrients and maintain a good aquatic environment.

quote: The farming of this fish is largely based on live fish feeding, that greatly affects its culturing environment, and also cause high market price.
statement: 该鱼类的养殖主要依赖活鱼投喂，这极大地影响了其养殖环境，并导致高昂的市场价格。
text_zh: 该鱼类的养殖主要依赖活鱼投喂，这极大地影响了其养殖环境，并导致高昂的市场价格。
text_en: The farming of this fish species mainly relies on live fish feeding, which greatly affects its farming environment and leads to high market prices.

quote: However, after successful weaning on artificial diet, now it has a great research importance to optimize its artificial diet to improve Chinese perch farming and cost-effective culture environment to produce healthy fish and increase aquaculture production.
statement: 在成功驯食人工饲料后，优化人工饲料配方对于改善中国鳜鱼养殖、构建具有成本效益的养殖环境以生产健康鱼类并增加水产产量具有重要意义。
text_zh: 在成功驯食人工饲料后，优化人工饲料配方对于改善中国鳜鱼养殖、构建具有成本效益的养殖环境以生产健康鱼类并增加水产产量具有重要意义。
text_en: After successful acclimation to artificial feed, optimizing the artificial diet formulation is of great significance for improving Chinese mandarin fish farming, building a cost-effective farming environment to produce healthy fish and increase aquaculture yield.

quote: Effects of different P/E ratio diets on the mRNA expression of appetite regulation genes in Chinese perch: (a) NPY, (b) AgRP, (c) POMC, and (d) CART.
statement: 不同蛋白/能量比日粮影响鳜鱼食欲调节基因（NPY、AgRP、POMC和CART）的mRNA表达。
text_zh: 不同蛋白/能量比日粮影响鳜鱼食欲调节基因（NPY、AgRP、POMC和CART）的mRNA表达。
text_en: Diets with different protein/energy ratios affect the mRNA expression of appetite-regulating genes (NPY, AgRP, POMC and CART) in mandarin fish.

quote: Effect of probiotics used on pH in treated group and in control group.
statement: 使用益生菌对处理组和对照组的pH值有影响。
text_zh: 使用益生菌对处理组和对照组的pH值有影响。
text_en: The use of probiotics had an effect on the pH values of the treatment and control groups.

quote: Effect of probiotics used on NH4+-N in treated group and in control group.
statement: 使用益生菌对处理组和对照组的铵态氮含量有影响。
text_zh: 使用益生菌对处理组和对照组的铵态氮含量有影响。
text_en: The use of probiotics had an effect on the ammonium nitrogen content in both the treatment and control groups.

quote: Effect of probiotics used on Nitrite in treated group and in control group.
statement: 使用益生菌对处理组和对照组的亚硝酸盐含量有影响。
text_zh: 使用益生菌对处理组和对照组的亚硝酸盐含量有影响。
text_en: The use of probiotics had an effect on nitrite content in the treatment and control groups.

quote: 目前针对于翘嘴鳜的养殖主要基于活鱼饲养，这极大地限制了它的养殖，同时活饵料成本高也导致翘嘴鳜市场价格很高。
statement: 目前翘嘴鳜养殖主要依赖活鱼投喂，这种方式限制了养殖规模并推高了成本和市场售价。
text_zh: 目前翘嘴鳜养殖主要依赖活鱼投喂，这种方式限制了养殖规模并推高了成本和市场售价。
text_en: Currently, the farming of Siniperca chuatsi mainly relies on feeding with live fish; this method limits the scale of farming and drives up costs and market prices.

quote: 在此背景下，本课题研究了研究了饲料蛋白质/能量比对翘嘴鳜其饵料鱼（麦鲮）生长和代谢的影响，并比较了饲料直接投喂（饲料喂养鳜鱼）和间接投喂（通过饵料鱼）对翘嘴鳜生长性能、摄食量、饲料利用率、鱼体成分、氮代谢酶、基因表达和AMPK-mTOR 信号通路的影响。
statement: 本研究评估了饲料蛋白能比对饵料鱼的影响，并对比了直接投喂与通过饵料鱼间接投喂对翘嘴鳜多项生理指标的影响。
text_zh: 本研究评估了饲料蛋白能比对饵料鱼的影响，并对比了直接投喂与通过饵料鱼间接投喂对翘嘴鳜多项生理指标的影响。
text_en: This study evaluated the effect of dietary protein energy ratio on bait fish, and compared the effects of direct feeding versus indirect feeding via bait fish on multiple physiological indicators of Chinese perch (Siniperca chuatsi).

quote: 此外，还评估了益生菌在改善翘嘴鳜养殖池塘中水质和饲料利用的作用。
statement: 研究评估了益生菌对改善养殖池塘水质和提高饲料利用率的作用。
text_zh: 研究评估了益生菌对改善养殖池塘水质和提高饲料利用率的作用。
text_en: The study evaluated the effect of probiotics on improving water quality in aquaculture ponds and increasing feed utilization.

quote: 然而，饲料中高蛋白质添加使其养殖成本增加，从而影响翘嘴鳜销量。因此，如何在不影响翘嘴鳜健康生长的情况下降低饲料蛋白质成本，这对研究者来说是一个很有意义的研究课题。
statement: 高蛋白质饲料增加了养殖成本并影响销量，需在保证健康生长的前提下降低蛋白质成本。
text_zh: 高蛋白质饲料增加了养殖成本并影响销量，需在保证健康生长的前提下降低蛋白质成本。
text_en: High-protein feed increased aquaculture costs and affected sales volume; it is necessary to reduce protein costs while ensuring healthy growth.

quote: 将225 尾翘嘴鳜（64.89 ± 0.28 克）分成5 组，每组3 个平行养殖在350 L 玻璃纤维缸中（每缸15 条鱼），按翘嘴鳜体重4％投喂不同的P/E 饲料，每天投喂两次，养殖周期为10 周。
statement: 实验采用玻璃纤维缸养殖，密度为每缸15条，按体重4%每日两次投喂不同蛋白能比饲料，持续10周。
text_zh: 实验采用玻璃纤维缸养殖，密度为每缸15条，按体重4%每日两次投喂不同蛋白能比饲料，持续10周。
text_en: The experiment used fiberglass tanks for rearing, with a density of 15 fish per tank, fed twice daily at 4% of body weight with diets of different protein-to-energy ratios, for 10 weeks.

quote: Our result suggests that both probiotics PSB and Nitrobacteria balance ratios addition can promote healthy water quality, sediments nutrients and good environments in Chinese perch pond culture.
statement: 研究结果表明，添加光合细菌（PSB）和硝化细菌的平衡比例可以促进中国鳜鱼池塘养殖中的健康水质、沉积物营养和良好的环境。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，添加光合细菌（PSB）和硝化细菌的平衡比例可以促进中国鳜鱼池塘养殖中的健康水质、沉积物营养和良好的环境。
text_en: The results indicate that adding a balanced ratio of photosynthetic bacteria (PSB) and nitrifying bacteria can promote healthy water quality, sediment nutrients, and a good environment in pond farming of Chinese mandarin fish.

quote: Furthermore, the blood biochemicals ALT, AST, total protein (TP), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), glucose (GLU), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and triglyceride (TG) levels were also affected by the dietary P/E ratio.
statement: 此外，血液生化指标ALT、AST、总蛋白、碱性磷酸酶、葡萄糖、血尿素氮和甘油三酯水平也受日粮蛋白能比的影响。
text_zh: 此外，血液生化指标ALT、AST、总蛋白、碱性磷酸酶、葡萄糖、血尿素氮和甘油三酯水平也受日粮蛋白能比的影响。
text_en: In addition, blood biochemical indicators ALT, AST, total protein, alkaline phosphatase, glucose, blood urea nitrogen and triglyceride levels were also affected by the dietary P/E ratio.

quote: The present results showed that dietary P/E ratio of artificial diets, significantly affected Chinese perch growth and metabolism.
statement: 人工饲料的蛋白/能量比显著影响鳜鱼的生长和代谢。
text_zh: 人工饲料的蛋白/能量比显著影响鳜鱼的生长和代谢。
text_en: The protein/energy ratio of artificial feed significantly affects the growth and metabolism of mandarin fish.

quote: 低温条件可以调控斑马鱼aqp1b 基因甲基化水平
statement: 低温条件可调控斑马鱼aqp1b基因的甲基化水平。
text_zh: 低温条件可调控斑马鱼aqp1b基因的甲基化水平。
text_en: Low temperature conditions can regulate the methylation level of the aqp1b gene in zebrafish.

quote: 分别对生长快速和慢速的鱼类胚胎进行4 ℃和8 ℃温度处理，在快速生长组中，温度较高的环境下孵育出的幼鱼其生长性能与DNA 甲基化水平相关
statement: 在大西洋鲑快速生长组中，较高温度孵育出的幼鱼其生长性能与DNA甲基化水平相关。
text_zh: 在大西洋鲑快速生长组中，较高温度孵育出的幼鱼其生长性能与DNA甲基化水平相关。
text_en: In the fast-growing group of Atlantic salmon, the growth performance of juveniles hatched at higher temperatures was associated with DNA methylation levels.

quote: 半滑舌蹋在0.15 %的盐度中暴露一段时间后，肝脏中胰岛素生长因子基因发生高度甲基化，mRNA 表达水平显著降低，导致生长迟缓
statement: 半滑舌蹋在0.15%盐度暴露后，肝脏胰岛素生长因子基因高度甲基化，mRNA表达降低，导致生长迟缓。
text_zh: 半滑舌蹋在0.15%盐度暴露后，肝脏胰岛素生长因子基因高度甲基化，mRNA表达降低，导致生长迟缓。
text_en: After exposure to 0.15% salinity, the liver insulin growth factor gene of Channa argus was highly methylated, mRNA expression decreased, leading to stunted growth.

quote: 对污染水域生长的鱼类进行甲基化分析后发现，其与性腺发育相关的一些基因发生了高度甲基化，从而造成性腺发育缓慢
statement: 污染水域生长的鱼类中性腺发育相关基因高度甲基化，导致性腺发育缓慢。
text_zh: 污染水域生长的鱼类中性腺发育相关基因高度甲基化，导致性腺发育缓慢。
text_en: Fish growing in polluted waters have highly methylated genes related to gonadal development, resulting in slow gonadal development.

quote: 在农药的处理后，其DNA 甲基化的水平会发生一定的影响，从而影响其组织表达
statement: 农药处理影响鲤脑组织DNA甲基化水平，进而影响组织表达。
text_zh: 农药处理影响鲤脑组织DNA甲基化水平，进而影响组织表达。
text_en: Pesticide treatment affects DNA methylation levels in carp brain tissue, thereby affecting tissue expression.

quote: 若鱼类生存的污染水域内含有大量的重金属，则可以使机体产生氧化还原反应后损伤DNA，从而引起DNA 甲基化水平的变化
statement: 污染水域中的大量重金属可通过氧化还原反应损伤DNA，引起DNA甲基化水平变化。
text_zh: 污染水域中的大量重金属可通过氧化还原反应损伤DNA，引起DNA甲基化水平变化。
text_en: Large amounts of heavy metals in polluted waters can damage DNA through redox reactions, causing changes in DNA methylation levels.

quote: 对欧洲鳗进行镉胁迫后发现，其相关基因的甲基化水平发生了改变
statement: 镉胁迫导致欧洲鳗相关基因甲基化水平改变。
text_zh: 镉胁迫导致欧洲鳗相关基因甲基化水平改变。
text_en: Cadmium stress led to changes in the methylation levels of genes related to European eels.

quote: 在大黄鱼的研究中发现，饲料中LNA/LA 的添加比例在0.45-0.90 的时候，鱼体的生长性能及免疫能力达到最佳（左然涛等 2013）
statement: 已有研究报道，大黄鱼饲料中LNA/LA添加比例在0.45-0.90时，其生长性能和免疫能力达到最佳。
text_zh: 已有研究报道，大黄鱼饲料中LNA/LA添加比例在0.45-0.90时，其生长性能和免疫能力达到最佳。
text_en: Studies have reported that the growth performance and immune capacity of large yellow croaker reach their optimum when the LNA/LA addition ratio in feed is 0.45-0.90.

quote: 曾芸芸等指出，草鱼幼鱼最适LNA/LA 的需求比值为1.08（曾芸芸等 2015）
statement: 已有研究指出，草鱼幼鱼最适的LNA/LA需求比值为1.08。
text_zh: 已有研究指出，草鱼幼鱼最适的LNA/LA需求比值为1.08。
text_en: Existing research indicates that the optimal LNA/LA requirement ratio for grass carp juveniles is 1.08.

quote: 在本研究中，通过观察H&E 染色的肠道切片分析得出，在添加亚麻油的四个实验组肠道绒毛长度均有显著升高，在D3 组显示最高，说明适宜比例LNA/LA 的添加可促进肠道对营养物质的吸收。
statement: 本研究通过H&E染色观察发现，添加亚麻油的实验组鳜鱼肠道绒毛长度显著升高，其中D3组最高，表明适宜比例的LNA/LA添加能促进肠道对营养物质的吸收。
text_zh: 本研究通过H&E染色观察发现，添加亚麻油的实验组鳜鱼肠道绒毛长度显著升高，其中D3组最高，表明适宜比例的LNA/LA添加能促进肠道对营养物质的吸收。
text_en: This study found through H&E staining that the intestinal villus length of mandarin fish in the experimental group supplemented with linseed oil was significantly increased, with the D3 group being the highest, indicating that an appropriate ratio of LNA/LA supplementation can promote the absorption of nutrients by the intestine.

quote: 在奥尼罗非鱼 (Oreochromis niloticus × O.aureus) 饲料中添加甘露低聚糖后，发现肠道绒毛长度、宽度、密度均显著性升高（刘爱君等 2009）。
statement: 已有研究报道，在奥尼罗非鱼饲料中添加甘露低聚糖后，其肠道绒毛的长度、宽度和密度均显著升高。
text_zh: 已有研究报道，在奥尼罗非鱼饲料中添加甘露低聚糖后，其肠道绒毛的长度、宽度和密度均显著升高。
text_en: Studies have reported that after adding mannan oligosaccharides to the feed of Oreochromis niloticus × O. aureus, the length, width, and density of their intestinal villi all increased significantly.

quote: A well balanced and nutritionally good quality feed can cause poor growth performance if the proper and adequate feeding management practices (daily schedules feeding, methods and frequency of feed, feed allowance) are not used (Lim and Poernomo 1985).
statement: 即使饲料营养均衡且质量良好，如果缺乏适当的饲喂管理措施（如每日投喂时间表、方法和频率、投喂量），也会导致生长性能不佳。
text_zh: 即使饲料营养均衡且质量良好，如果缺乏适当的饲喂管理措施（如每日投喂时间表、方法和频率、投喂量），也会导致生长性能不佳。
text_en: Even if the feed is nutritionally balanced and of good quality, a lack of appropriate feeding management measures (such as daily feeding schedules, methods and frequency, and feeding amounts) can also lead to poor growth performance.

quote: Fish feed among other factors have showed robust influence on fish health and stress tolerance, therefore it is necessary to feed fish with well-balanced and nutritionally rich feed for the proper growth and to have the ability to cope with stress and diseases (Trichet 2010).
statement: 鱼类饲料对鱼的健康和应激耐受性有显著影响，因此需要提供营养均衡丰富的饲料以促进正常生长并增强应对压力和疾病的能力。
text_zh: 鱼类饲料对鱼的健康和应激耐受性有显著影响，因此需要提供营养均衡丰富的饲料以促进正常生长并增强应对压力和疾病的能力。
text_en: Fish feed has a significant impact on fish health and stress tolerance, therefore providing nutritionally balanced and rich feed is necessary to promote normal growth and enhance the ability to cope with stress and disease.

quote: Fish farming foundation is basically relay on nutritional quality of fish feed and their adequate arrangement, the success and failure of fish farming mainly determine by the fish feed.
statement: 水产养殖的基础主要依赖于鱼饲料的营养质量及其合理配置，养殖的成败主要由鱼饲料决定。
text_zh: 水产养殖的基础主要依赖于鱼饲料的营养质量及其合理配置，养殖的成败主要由鱼饲料决定。
text_en: The foundation of aquaculture mainly depends on the nutritional quality and reasonable formulation of fish feed, and the success or failure of farming is mainly determined by fish feed.

quote:
Fish growth, general health, behavior,
reproduction, structural veracity and environment greatly effect by the nutrition of the fish
(Weatherley et al 1987).
statement: 鱼类的生长、一般健康、行为、繁殖、结构真实性和环境受鱼类营养的极大影响。
text_zh: 鱼类的生长、一般健康、行为、繁殖、结构真实性和环境受鱼类营养的极大影响。
text_en: The growth, general health, behavior, reproduction, structural integrity and environment of fish are greatly influenced by fish nutrition.

quote: Whereas, fish in Group A showed lowest growth performance, feed utilization and body composition as compared to other groups.
statement: 与其他组相比，A组鱼表现出最低的生长性能、饲料利用率和体成分指标。
text_zh: 与其他组相比，A组鱼表现出最低的生长性能、饲料利用率和体成分指标。
text_en: Compared with the other groups, fish in Group A showed the lowest growth performance, feed utilization, and body composition indices.
outcome: 生长性能与饲料利用率

quote: The nitrogen metabolism-related enzyme activities, alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST) glutamate dehydrogenase and adenosine 5′-monophosphate deaminase (AMPD), as well as GDH and AMPD genes expression of fish in Group A were significantly lower than other groups.
statement: A组鱼的氮代谢相关酶活性（ALT、AST、GDH、AMPD）以及GDH和AMPD基因表达显著低于其他组。
text_zh: A组鱼的氮代谢相关酶活性（ALT、AST、GDH、AMPD）以及GDH和AMPD基因表达显著低于其他组。
text_en: The activities of nitrogen metabolism-related enzymes (ALT, AST, GDH, AMPD) and the gene expression of GDH and AMPD in fish in Group A were significantly lower than those in other groups.

quote: Similarly, among the appetite regulation genes (NPY, AgRP, POMC and CART), gene expression of NPY and AgRp were significantly higher in Group C as compared to other groups.
statement: 在食欲调节基因中，C组的NPY和AgRP基因表达显著高于其他组。
text_zh: 在食欲调节基因中，C组的NPY和AgRP基因表达显著高于其他组。
text_en: Among appetite-regulating genes, NPY and AgRP gene expression in Group C was significantly higher than in the other groups.

quote:
Chinese perch, special live feeding behavior makes aquaculture practice
and consumer price high, that‘s droved strong research interest for live feed optimization.
statement: 鳜鱼特殊的活饵摄食行为导致养殖实践成本和消费者价格高昂，这激发了对优化活饵的研究兴趣。
text_zh: 鳜鱼特殊的活饵摄食行为导致养殖实践成本和消费者价格高昂，这激发了对优化活饵的研究兴趣。
text_en: The special live-feed feeding behavior of mandarin fish leads to high costs in aquaculture practices and consumer prices, which has stimulated research interest in optimizing live feed.

quote:
Therefore, the present study was conducted to investigate the indirect effect of dietary
protein to energy ratio of bait fish (mrigal) (fed various dietary P/E ratio diets) on Chinese
perch.
statement: 因此，本研究旨在调查饵料鱼（鲮鱼）日粮蛋白/能量比对鳜鱼的间接影响。
text_zh: 因此，本研究旨在调查饵料鱼（鲮鱼）日粮蛋白/能量比对鳜鱼的间接影响。
text_en: Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the indirect effects of the dietary protein/energy ratio of forage fish (mud carp) on mandarin fish.

quote: 氮代谢酶，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶，谷氨酸脱氢酶，谷氨酸脱氢酶和腺苷5'-单磷酸脱氨酶（AST，ALT，GDH 和AMPD）的活性随着饲料P/E 比增加而增高。
statement: 麦鲮体内氮代谢酶（AST, ALT, GDH, AMPD）的活性随饲料P/E比的增加而升高。
text_zh: 麦鲮体内氮代谢酶（AST, ALT, GDH, AMPD）的活性随饲料P/E比的增加而升高。
text_en: The activities of nitrogen metabolism enzymes (AST, ALT, GDH, AMPD) in Cirrhinus mrigala increased with increasing dietary P/E ratio.

quote: 通过对不同组别麦鲮FCR 进行二阶多项式回归分析表明，麦鲮的最佳饲料P/E 比为22.61 mg/kJ。
statement: 基于饲料转化率(FCR)的二阶多项式回归分析确定麦鲮的最佳饲料P/E比为22.61 mg/kJ。
text_zh: 基于饲料转化率(FCR)的二阶多项式回归分析确定麦鲮的最佳饲料P/E比为22.61 mg/kJ。
text_en: Second-order polynomial regression analysis based on feed conversion ratio (FCR) determined that the optimal dietary protein/energy (P/E) ratio for Cirrhinus mrigala is 22.61 mg/kJ.

quote: 饲喂A 组饲料的麦鲮的增重、特定生长率和蛋白质效率比显著降低，VSI 和HSI 显著升高，而B 组和C 组之间所有生长指标均无显著性差异。
statement: 与B组和C组相比，饲喂低P/E比饲料（A组）的麦鲮生长性能指标（增重、SGR、PER）显著降低，而内脏指数（VSI、HSI）显著升高；B组和C组间生长指标无显著差异。
text_zh: 与B组和C组相比，饲喂低P/E比饲料（A组）的麦鲮生长性能指标（增重、SGR、PER）显著降低，而内脏指数（VSI、HSI）显著升高；B组和C组间生长指标无显著差异。
text_en: Compared with groups B and C, the growth performance indicators (weight gain, SGR, PER) of Cirrhinus mrigala fed a low protein/energy ratio diet (group A) were significantly lower, while the visceral indices (VSI, HSI) were significantly higher; there was no significant difference in growth indicators between groups B and C.

quote: 在翘嘴鳜中，与B 组和C 组相比，A 组的特定生长率和PER 均显著降低，而A 组的采食量、饲料转化率、VSI、HSI 和IPF 与B 组和C 组比较显著升高。
statement: 摄食来自A组饲料麦鲮的翘嘴鳜，其特定生长率和蛋白质效率比显著低于B组和C组，但采食量、饲料转化率及内脏指数（VSI, HSI, IPF）显著高于B组和C组。
text_zh: 摄食来自A组饲料麦鲮的翘嘴鳜，其特定生长率和蛋白质效率比显著低于B组和C组，但采食量、饲料转化率及内脏指数（VSI, HSI, IPF）显著高于B组和C组。
text_en: Topmouth culter fed on mud carp from feed group A had significantly lower specific growth rate and protein efficiency ratio than those in groups B and C, but significantly higher feed intake, feed conversion ratio, and visceral indices (VSI, HSI, IPF) than those in groups B and C.
intervention: Indirect feeding via bait fish pre-fed extruded feed
intervention_record: 间接喂饲（饵料鱼预食膨化饲料）

quote: 与之相同的是，与其他两组相比，翘嘴鳜鱼体和肌肉粗蛋白含量显著低于其他两组，脂肪水平较高，氮代谢酶活性及相关基因表达随P/E 比值的增加呈上升趋势。
statement: 摄食A组饵料鱼的翘嘴鳜，其鱼体和肌肉粗蛋白含量显著较低，脂肪水平较高；且其氮代谢酶活性及相关基因表达随饵料鱼饲料P/E比的增加呈上升趋势。
text_zh: 摄食A组饵料鱼的翘嘴鳜，其鱼体和肌肉粗蛋白含量显著较低，脂肪水平较高；且其氮代谢酶活性及相关基因表达随饵料鱼饲料P/E比的增加呈上升趋势。
text_en: Farmed topmouth culpeo fed with Group A bait fish had significantly lower whole-body and muscle crude protein content, and higher fat levels; moreover, their nitrogen metabolism enzyme activity and related gene expression increased as the P/E ratio of the bait fish feed increased.
intervention: Indirect feeding via bait fish pre-fed extruded feed
intervention_record: 间接喂饲（饵料鱼预食膨化饲料）

quote: 益生菌的使用是水产养殖中一种常见的用于改善池塘水质和周围环境的方法。
statement: 在水产养殖中，使用益生菌是一种常用于改善池塘水质和周围环境的实践方法。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，使用益生菌是一种常用于改善池塘水质和周围环境的实践方法。
text_en: In aquaculture, the use of probiotics is a common practice to improve pond water quality and the surrounding environment.

quote: Lipids within specific limits are often used in fish feed for the protein sparing effect
statement: 脂质通常在特定限度内用于鱼类饲料中以产生蛋白质节省效应。
text_zh: 脂质通常在特定限度内用于鱼类饲料中以产生蛋白质节省效应。
text_en: Lipids are usually used in fish feed within specific limits to produce a protein-sparing effect.

quote: Therefore, this is a limiting factor in many fish diet to increase lipids level, without compromising, on health, growth and body composition of cultures species.
statement: 因此，在许多鱼类日粮中提高脂质水平是一个限制因素，因为不能损害养殖物种的健康、生长和体成分。
text_zh: 因此，在许多鱼类日粮中提高脂质水平是一个限制因素，因为不能损害养殖物种的健康、生长和体成分。
text_en: Therefore, increasing lipid levels in many fish diets is a limiting factor because it cannot compromise the health, growth, and body composition of farmed species.
limitations: enormous difference in the ability of utilizing high lipids in fish species
